guitar.modelsText: G&L Rampage (early) / Gibson Les Paul (signature model)
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Cantrell is well documented playing a G&L Rampage in early Alice in Chains years, later closely associated with Gibson Les Paul (his own signature model).
guitar.notes: Original entry correct and well documented.

tone.target: thick detuned grunge crunch with dry mid scoop
tone.profile: thick detuned grunge crunch with dry mid scoop
tone.summary: A tight, aggressive signal chain using a distortion pedal and an 80s-style amp (UK 800) paired with a robust 4x12 cabinet to achieve the required detuned, crunchy sound.
corrections: use dry heavy crunch, not fuzzy wash

rig.name: Alice in Chains - Man In The Box - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum inherent in grunge/metal tones.
Add grit and tighten the low-mids for palm-muted aggression.
blocks.gap: The OD 9 is used here to shape the tone rather than just boost, providing necessary bite before high gain.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core high-gain crunch and detuned character.
Simulate the high-gain, aggressive tone associated with 80s hard rock/grunge.
Provide the necessary punch and aggressive voicing of a classic rock cabinet.
Achieve the required 'dry mid scoop' and tighten the low-end grind.
Disabled as per the 'avoid' list and corrections.
Add minimal space and definition without sounding washed out.
Provide minimal room ambience as requested (avoiding deep reverb).

improvements.summary: Replace the generic cabinet IR with a specific, tight 4x12 model optimized for aggressive grunge/alt-metal tones.

proposals.recommendedAsset: tight 4x12 alt-rock IR (e.g., Mesa Boogie or similar)
proposals.reason: The current 'Vintage 4x12' is too generic; a tighter, more aggressive cab will improve the punch and bite needed for grunge.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased tightness and definition in low-mids.
